programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. Running out of air, Barnacles struggles to free his paw from the mouth of a giant clam, while simultaneously directing his crew in a delicate manatee rescue operation.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: A fantastic treat awaits the Numberblocks if they can figure out how to ride the rays to the top of Ray Canyon. Solve a number puzzle with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. B the bassist and her brother D the drummer get new guitarist N to join the band, but they still need a singer. They try auditioning the vowels but make some strange sounds before the band is complete.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Nugget’s new fitness device sparks a craze on the berg. Running, skating and jumping, the Piris battle it out to score the most points, with a surprise winner.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit Patch in the Cloud Kitchen, but he has lost one of his boots - it was stolen by a cheeky crab. This gives him a great idea for a tasty treat - crabby croissant.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: 'The sparkles came back and they were everywhere and there was enough magic for everyone.' Bing goes to play with Sula, who is engrossed in a game of sparkle magic when he arrives. Bing wants to play too, but Sula finds all sorts of reasons why Bing can't play with her special sparkly things. Amma suggests that Bing makes his own magic stone, but disaster strikes when Bing accidentally spills Sula's precious sparkle dust.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘socks’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. Today, we see lots of different socks – stripy socks, spotty socks, long socks and short socks. There are summer socks, cosy socks and toes-y socks. We see some doggy socks, some soggy socks and even meet some super socks! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu gets jealous when Biba hits it off with Uncle Lorcan.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri and Lou fall down a hole into a cave and are guided to safety by some singing glow-worms.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: The Froglets don homemade skis and snowboards to whiz down a mountain of winter duvets.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos are at a farm, where they watch a boy and girl collecting eggs from a hen house. When the children are called away by their mother, the Twirlywoos decide to collect more eggs from the other hen houses in the chicken enclosure, and the children return to discover their basket brimming over with eggs! Back in the boat, Peekaboo sweeps a pile of colourful pebbles out of the hole in the wall, and they scatter across the boat. The Twirlywoos return, and begin to collect the pebbles into piles. Great BigHoo carefully collects all the blue ones, Toodloo collects the red ones, and Chickedy and Chick run in pushing a pile of yellow pebbles, crashing into the others and scattering them everywhere! The Rings signal that it's time to go, and Peekaboo comes out when the coast is clear and pushes the pebbles back into the hole in the wall!

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin meets Seun at the farm. They spot lots of different wheels, some big and some small, and Seun rides a go-kart. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble pretends to be a bus driver and takes the toys for a ride. There's a tractor ride in today's spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words wheel, driving and tractor.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: When the lights go out in the Home Dome, the Teletubbies get the giggles! The lights come back on again and there is Tubby Custard mess everywhere.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Roman, Rose-may, Eliza, Theo, Joseph, George, Gracie and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are oranges which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby-appropriate oranges inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun rhyme ‘Juicy Orange’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children craft paper sheep, learn British Sign Language signs for sheep, where and home, then sing and sign Little Bo Peep Has Lost Her Sheep.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Gardening expert Sue introduces the Fact Pack to roses. They discover that there are hundreds of types, why roses can smell lovely, and how their smell and flavour is in many different things.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: It’s recycling day in the attic – and it's also Murphi’s hairdo day! The first idea is a hilarious hairdo pot, the Mini Monsters make a variety of cheese box octopuses, and the Magic Monster Mirror brings a call from Rebecca’s aunt. Finally, the Recycling Express arrives with some buttons that Murphi and Rebecca use to create a brilliant box robot.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes go on an underwater adventure inside a rubbery bubble.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: On a trip to the dump, Dad claims he’s the best at everything. But Bluey discovers that Dad's throwing out her old drawing and questions if he really is the best Dad in the world.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Happy notices a tiny fruit fly on his apple, and the Squirrels are amazed by how small it is. The fly tells them that there are things even smaller than him, and so Duggee teaches them that some things are so small that you can’t even see them – atoms. Combined, these make molecules, which in turn join to make cells, the fabric that makes up every living thing. The Squirrels discover that things can be wide, long, thin or small, and that these attributes make up all sorts of different sizes. To help understand this, they assign a line-up all the way from a small piece of dust to a huge rocket ship.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk through the city and along the river to a place where they can draw pictures. On the way they discover birds called cormorants, go as fast a rollercoaster, find a big compass on the ground, and play a game with colours!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: All rise for Queen Audrey! She plays a fun royal game and holds a special tea party for one of her favourite dolls. There are also lots of jewels and sparkles with some precious homemade necklaces. What will Mummy make of her glittery surprise? Later, the family heads out for a trip to the beach, where they have a splashing good time.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Aleisha's family comes from Uganda. Today, she is cooking the traditional meal of rolex, which is a Ugandan omelette. Aleisha uses tasty fresh vegetables such as baby tomatoes, cabbage, red onion and her special ingredient, mild green chilli, for her omelettes. She pours whisked eggs into baking tins and puts her vegetables on top. Then her recipe is ready to be cooked for her friends to enjoy. To top off the occasion, Aleisha wears a wonderful Ugandan outfit and has a musical surprise planned for her pals. Will Aleisha's friends guess her secret ingredient?

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In today’s episode, Maddie is finding out about the weather. She discovers why we have clouds and rain, and how the water cycle works. We learn there are lots of different types of clouds, but the clouds that make rain are called nimbus clouds. Maddie visits the national weather centre where they make the weather reports. She finds out how satellites high up in space can see the clouds moving and tell us when it might rain. Next, Maddie visits a radiator factory to find out how radiators are made to keep our houses warm. We see how big flat sheets of metal are pressed to make grooves, like teeth. The metal pieces are heated up and sealed together to make sure the water doesn’t leak out. Maddie takes her special camera on a journey along the radiator ‘washing line’, and we see how the radiators are sprayed with special paint to make them shiny.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Disability assistance dog Tinks and her owner Charli have a long list of chores to do, all in time for Annabel, their last minute visitor!

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie head out to meet a reticulated python, the longest snake in the world. These super stealthy snakes get their name from the amazing, triangulated pattern on their scales. It’s reticulated, which means it is shaped like a net. These sit-and-wait predators hide in the undergrowth, blending in to stay hidden by passing prey until they are close enough to strike. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie head out to feed two pelicans. They are one of the largest birds on earth and have giant mouths, called a gular, to scoop up fish. They use it to catch their food as Aneeshwar and Lizzie feed them fish for lunch. These two animals are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Summer is here! Hooray! But, where’s Mossy?

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Stripes has borrowed Twinkle's xylophone, but he has lost it - and right before her performance! The gang race around the garden, listening for clues. But will they find it in time?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: While searching for unique sounds that their bodies can make, Mum introduces Maddie and Triggs to one of the tiniest sounds of all - the sound of their own heartbeat.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are at the Clubhouse playing, but they can’t stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Luckily, Duggee has his dream badge and can help the Squirrels work out what they mean. As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggee’s dream!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Ten promises to take the others on a trip to the moon, but blasts off on her own. How will they get there? Find out which pairs of numbers add together to make ten with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. S, P, A, C and E wonder what is up past the sky, and soon find out.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Ben meets Gabe at the park for some den building and hide-and-seek. Mr Tumble and Grandad are playing hide-and-seek too - by mistake! There is a treasure hunt in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words tree, hiding and magnifying glass.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Laa-Laa has fun counting to three: 1, 2, 3 rabbits, 1, 2, 3 flowers and 1, 2, 3 trees! Laa-Laa even counts three Teletubbies: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how hedges play an important role in the environment. They find out that hedges are a shelter for all types of animals and insects, and that they can help reduce air and noise pollution. On the way, they look closely at what’s living in a hedge, before pretending to be animals looking for a hedge to hide in!

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: Sophie must infiltrate the sports hall without disturbing a relaxation class Val is running. Her aim is to retrieve bibs, goals and a big bag of footballs.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that work in docks! Grace helps use a huge mobile harbour crane, shows off the amazing tandem lifting crane and then drives a reach stacker!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: It's so cold in the Valley that the Pea-Rexes risk becoming frozen!

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: When birds cause trouble aboard the Octoray, Tweak uses her Octowatch to help with repairs

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Peter is charged with minding Ginger and Pickles's store, he finds running a shop is no easy feat, especially with customers like Sammy Whiskers!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Chipmunk is cycling one day delivering his packages when he hits a rock and his trike falls apart! He has so many packages to deliver - what is he going to do now? Duggee offers to repair Delivery Chipmunk’s trike, but that will take too long. The packages need to be delivered right away or else! Duggee also has a delivery badge and he will try to deliver all of Chipmunk’s packages with the help of the Squirrels. Before they begin, they need to learn the rules of delivering. With some hard work, the Squirrels deliver all the packages and Delivery Chipmunk is alright again. The Squirrels have truly earned their delivery badge!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Juno decides to give up napping but soon has a cranky meltdown, as she is so tired.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato is delighted when Evil Pea becomes his sidekick, but it’s all a trick, and Evil Pea captures him! Evil Pea is forced to do a good deed because one of the cobs needs help.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy and the ducklings race around an obstacle course on a sheep and a chicken. When Weasy spots a device in the Farm of the Future that can give one animal the abilities of another, he sees his chance to win.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo needs to deliver a pizza to a very hard-to-reach island, but some stubborn seabirds have their eye on the pizza. Will Mojo have to go supersonic to get past them?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky’s family get together to watch the big game!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It is Bluey’s first trip to the cinema, but she’s worried that the movie will be too scary. When Bingo starts running amok in the theatre, she must conquer her fear and help Dad out.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Boom is showing off but slips and has a mild panic. To hide his embarrassment, he challenges Zog to a dragon-off! Zog must set aside his desire to win and help his rival.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Jen is monitoring some unusual earth tremors on Dino Island and uses a seismograph to research plate tectonics. Meanwhile, Andy is hungry and desperate to head to Dino Island for a practically perfect prehistoric picnic, so Jen asks him to get some seismic readings while he is out and about. Along the way, Andy meets some peckish Pachycephalosaurus, a hungry T. rex and a pterosaur.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Ruby and Finn’s seeds have started to grow, but Rafi’s cherry seed shows no change. Feeling left out, she makes a wish, and a giant cherry tree appears! It’s exciting at first, but when the wish ends, everything disappears. Rafi feels sad, until Doris shares a story about planting an apple tree when she was little. Rafi realises that nature likes to take its time and waiting can bring something special.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran visit Jared’s shop, which really does stock everything, and everything has a place. When they get home, JoJo decides to open her own shop with her till and panda pounds. Having found lots of things that they can sell, JoJo is disappointed when she can’t quickly find what her customers want to buy. Gran Gran has a plan, and soon everything has a place – perfect for JoJo and Gran Gran’s customers Jared and Cynthia to find just what they want to buy.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah is awarded a crown by the ducks at the pond, so she tries to work out what her royal duties should be!

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Baby Soup Dragon is up early, looking for interesting things that might have fallen on the planet overnight. He finds several coloured jewel-like things and puts them in his collecting bag to show everyone. Small Clanger is also up early, fetching soup for breakfast as a surprise for the other Clangers. But when Baby Soup Dragon and Small’s soup trolley collide by accident in the soup wells, all the 'jewels' get scattered and covered in soup. No-one could have guessed what would happen next.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo is drawing a picture of BaBa, but BaBa can’t sit still. MeMo paints a picture at the Play Tree, but the Tweeties accidentally step all over it. BaBa loves the messy painting, as do the Yummies. They add their own flourishes, and MeMo starts to see its beauty. Pungi, Fungi and Elewhale also add to the picture. MeMo thinks it is a beautiful painting made by all their friends.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: The Wottingers call on the Pontipines but there is no reply, so they decide to go looking for them. But the Pontipines were in after all and go looking for the Wottingers. The Pontipines take a ride on the Ninky Nonk and wave at the Wottingers when they spot them.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Jill Scott reads a magical tale about a fairy who just wants to play football

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s the magical wish granter Mango, ready to make all the cast wishes come true!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Flop teaches Bing and Pando how to blow bubbles. Pando soon gets the hang of it, but Bing struggles and gets frustrated. Finally, Bing blows a big bubble and is outraged when Pando pops it.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Laa-Laa and Po laugh themselves silly with a funny joke, but when they tell it to Dipsy, it doesn't tickle Dipsy in the same way. But Dipsy's funny dance does and when Dipsy dances again, the Teletubbies all laugh together. In Tummy Tales, children have fun being silly in a park.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: Explore the amazing world around us with baby monkey Tee and his Mum, Mo. Sing along, join in with stories and get ready for some family fun!

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea befriends the playful but destructive Baby Watermelon to try and destroy Tato Tower. Her plan backfires when Baby Watermelon only wants to play with Evil Pea, and things get worse when she gets cranky because she's tired. The Veggies get Baby Watermelon into her crate for a nap by making Evil Pea sing her a lullaby. Evil Pea takes this opportunity to eject Supertato from the Tatocar and into the watermelon's crate! Fortunately, Supertato befriends Baby Watermelon's daddy, who scares Evil Pea back to the freezer.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Sula and Amma surprise Bing to show him Sula's sparkly painted butterfly face. Bing also wants a painted face, one that looks like Biteysaurus, and Sula says she can do it for him. Sula begins smothering his face in Bitey's signature green, but when she accidentally adds purple spots, Bing is horrified! He wants Sula to go home. But then Flop adds some teeth to Bing's Biteysaurus, so he can really be Bitey.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo only wanted to help fix a satellite dish with Mojo’s chopper top. Now they’ve been mistaken for a UFO, and the whole town is in a tizzy about invading aliens!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Introducing Squirrel Club today are Betty and Guinea Pig, jumping up and down, excited about what’s to come. Delivery Chipmunk delivers a massive parcel to Hennie, a Matryoshka Duggee appears, and there's an instalment of Agony and Eggstacy. Finally, Hatsu describes everything she likes - large, small, quiet, loud... Hatsu can see beauty in everything.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are excited to attend the cinema together for the first time with Duggee, who teaches them that you should adhere to three rules in order for everyone to enjoy the experience: stay quiet, don’t fidget or kick the chair in front and go to the toilet before the film starts. The Squirrels quickly learn that the short films they are enjoying are only trailers before the film starts. Hopefully, the Squirrels can maintain their focus in order to watch the film all the way through to the end credits and earn their cinema badges.

programme.desc: Aleisha's family comes from Uganda. Today, she is cooking the traditional meal of rolex, which is a Ugandan omelette. Aleisha uses tasty fresh vegetables such as baby tomatoes, cabbage, red onion and her special ingredient, mild green chilli, for her omelettes. She pours whisked eggs into baking tins and puts her vegetables on top. Then her recipe is ready to be cooked for her friends to enjoy. To top off the occasion, Aleisha wears a wonderful Ugandan outfit and has a musical surprise planned for her pals. Will Aleisha's friends guess her secret ingredient?

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In today’s episode, Maddie is finding out about the weather. She discovers why we have clouds and rain, and how the water cycle works. We learn there are lots of different types of clouds, but the clouds that make rain are called nimbus clouds. Maddie visits the national weather centre where they make the weather reports. She finds out how satellites high up in space can see the clouds moving and tell us when it might rain. Next, Maddie visits a radiator factory to find out how radiators are made to keep our houses warm. We see how big flat sheets of metal are pressed to make grooves, like teeth. The metal pieces are heated up and sealed together to make sure the water doesn’t leak out. Maddie takes her special camera on a journey along the radiator ‘washing line’, and we see how the radiators are sprayed with special paint to make them shiny.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Disability assistance dog Tinks and her owner Charli have a long list of chores to do, all in time for Annabel, their last minute visitor!

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie head out to meet a reticulated python, the longest snake in the world. These super stealthy snakes get their name from the amazing, triangulated pattern on their scales. It’s reticulated, which means it is shaped like a net. These sit-and-wait predators hide in the undergrowth, blending in to stay hidden by passing prey until they are close enough to strike. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie head out to feed two pelicans. They are one of the largest birds on earth and have giant mouths, called a gular, to scoop up fish. They use it to catch their food as Aneeshwar and Lizzie feed them fish for lunch. These two animals are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Summer is here! Hooray! But, where’s Mossy?

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Stripes has borrowed Twinkle's xylophone, but he has lost it - and right before her performance! The gang race around the garden, listening for clues. But will they find it in time?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: While searching for unique sounds that their bodies can make, Mum introduces Maddie and Triggs to one of the tiniest sounds of all - the sound of their own heartbeat.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are at the Clubhouse playing, but they can’t stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Luckily, Duggee has his dream badge and can help the Squirrels work out what they mean. As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggee’s dream!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Ten promises to take the others on a trip to the moon, but blasts off on her own. How will they get there? Find out which pairs of numbers add together to make ten with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. S, P, A, C and E wonder what is up past the sky, and soon find out.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Ben meets Gabe at the park for some den building and hide-and-seek. Mr Tumble and Grandad are playing hide-and-seek too - by mistake! There is a treasure hunt in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words tree, hiding and magnifying glass.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Laa-Laa has fun counting to three: 1, 2, 3 rabbits, 1, 2, 3 flowers and 1, 2, 3 trees! Laa-Laa even counts three Teletubbies: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how hedges play an important role in the environment. They find out that hedges are a shelter for all types of animals and insects, and that they can help reduce air and noise pollution. On the way, they look closely at what’s living in a hedge, before pretending to be animals looking for a hedge to hide in!

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: Sophie must infiltrate the sports hall without disturbing a relaxation class Val is running. Her aim is to retrieve bibs, goals and a big bag of footballs.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that work in docks! Grace helps use a huge mobile harbour crane, shows off the amazing tandem lifting crane and then drives a reach stacker!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: It's so cold in the Valley that the Pea-Rexes risk becoming frozen!

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: When birds cause trouble aboard the Octoray, Tweak uses her Octowatch to help with repairs

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Peter is charged with minding Ginger and Pickles's store, he finds running a shop is no easy feat, especially with customers like Sammy Whiskers!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Chipmunk is cycling one day delivering his packages when he hits a rock and his trike falls apart! He has so many packages to deliver - what is he going to do now? Duggee offers to repair Delivery Chipmunk’s trike, but that will take too long. The packages need to be delivered right away or else! Duggee also has a delivery badge and he will try to deliver all of Chipmunk’s packages with the help of the Squirrels. Before they begin, they need to learn the rules of delivering. With some hard work, the Squirrels deliver all the packages and Delivery Chipmunk is alright again. The Squirrels have truly earned their delivery badge!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Juno decides to give up napping but soon has a cranky meltdown, as she is so tired.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato is delighted when Evil Pea becomes his sidekick, but it’s all a trick, and Evil Pea captures him! Evil Pea is forced to do a good deed because one of the cobs needs help.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy and the ducklings race around an obstacle course on a sheep and a chicken. When Weasy spots a device in the Farm of the Future that can give one animal the abilities of another, he sees his chance to win.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo needs to deliver a pizza to a very hard-to-reach island, but some stubborn seabirds have their eye on the pizza. Will Mojo have to go supersonic to get past them?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky’s family get together to watch the big game!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It is Bluey’s first trip to the cinema, but she’s worried that the movie will be too scary. When Bingo starts running amok in the theatre, she must conquer her fear and help Dad out.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Boom is showing off but slips and has a mild panic. To hide his embarrassment, he challenges Zog to a dragon-off! Zog must set aside his desire to win and help his rival.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Jen is monitoring some unusual earth tremors on Dino Island and uses a seismograph to research plate tectonics. Meanwhile, Andy is hungry and desperate to head to Dino Island for a practically perfect prehistoric picnic, so Jen asks him to get some seismic readings while he is out and about. Along the way, Andy meets some peckish Pachycephalosaurus, a hungry T. rex and a pterosaur.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Ruby and Finn’s seeds have started to grow, but Rafi’s cherry seed shows no change. Feeling left out, she makes a wish, and a giant cherry tree appears! It’s exciting at first, but when the wish ends, everything disappears. Rafi feels sad, until Doris shares a story about planting an apple tree when she was little. Rafi realises that nature likes to take its time and waiting can bring something special.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran visit Jared’s shop, which really does stock everything, and everything has a place. When they get home, JoJo decides to open her own shop with her till and panda pounds. Having found lots of things that they can sell, JoJo is disappointed when she can’t quickly find what her customers want to buy. Gran Gran has a plan, and soon everything has a place – perfect for JoJo and Gran Gran’s customers Jared and Cynthia to find just what they want to buy.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah is awarded a crown by the ducks at the pond, so she tries to work out what her royal duties should be!

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Baby Soup Dragon is up early, looking for interesting things that might have fallen on the planet overnight. He finds several coloured jewel-like things and puts them in his collecting bag to show everyone. Small Clanger is also up early, fetching soup for breakfast as a surprise for the other Clangers. But when Baby Soup Dragon and Small’s soup trolley collide by accident in the soup wells, all the 'jewels' get scattered and covered in soup. No-one could have guessed what would happen next.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo is drawing a picture of BaBa, but BaBa can’t sit still. MeMo paints a picture at the Play Tree, but the Tweeties accidentally step all over it. BaBa loves the messy painting, as do the Yummies. They add their own flourishes, and MeMo starts to see its beauty. Pungi, Fungi and Elewhale also add to the picture. MeMo thinks it is a beautiful painting made by all their friends.

programme.desc: The Wottingers call on the Pontipines but there is no reply, so they decide to go looking for them. But the Pontipines were in after all and go looking for the Wottingers. The Pontipines take a ride on the Ninky Nonk and wave at the Wottingers when they spot them.

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: After an emotional farewell to their home and family in the UK, Becky and the kids make the big move to Italy, taking everything with them - including their dogs and grand piano. But Italian life is immediately complicated, with a frustrated Jamie injured and unable to play but desperate to start scoring goals for his new club. The kids love their new Italian home but struggle being away from friends - will Becky and Jamie's grand plans for Sofia's birthday be enough to take her mind off friends back home? With Jamie's punishing training schedule taking its toll, he doesn't get as much time with the family as he'd like, leaving Becky to help them settle in and do her best to source home comforts for the kids - but she can't find baked beans or orange squash anywhere. Still, Jamie makes time for some magic family moments, and the family begin to find their feet, learning the language, experiencing the culture and Jamie makes his much-awaited debut on the pitch with explosive results.

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. Becky and the kids escape to the mountains for a much-needed change of scenery and time to think clearly about their situation. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision: whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home. On Easter Sunday in Italy, Becky and Jamie reveal their decision to the kids during an Easter Egg hunt to an overwhelming reaction. Shortly after, Becky and Jamie fly the kids back to the UK, arriving home for an emotional reunion with family and friends. But when the season is over, will Jamie be joining them for good or stay in Italy - or will a whole new adventure begin?

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: After an emotional farewell to their home and family in the UK, Becky and the kids make the big move to Italy, taking everything with them - including their dogs and grand piano. But Italian life is immediately complicated, with a frustrated Jamie injured and unable to play but desperate to start scoring goals for his new club. The kids love their new Italian home but struggle being away from friends - will Becky and Jamie's grand plans for Sofia's birthday be enough to take her mind off friends back home? With Jamie's punishing training schedule taking its toll, he doesn't get as much time with the family as he'd like, leaving Becky to help them settle in and do her best to source home comforts for the kids - but she can't find baked beans or orange squash anywhere. Still, Jamie makes time for some magic family moments, and the family begin to find their feet, learning the language, experiencing the culture and Jamie makes his much-awaited debut on the pitch with explosive results.

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. Becky and the kids escape to the mountains for a much-needed change of scenery and time to think clearly about their situation. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision: whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home. On Easter Sunday in Italy, Becky and Jamie reveal their decision to the kids during an Easter Egg hunt to an overwhelming reaction. Shortly after, Becky and Jamie fly the kids back to the UK, arriving home for an emotional reunion with family and friends. But when the season is over, will Jamie be joining them for good or stay in Italy - or will a whole new adventure begin?

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. Becky and the kids escape to the mountains for a much-needed change of scenery and time to think clearly about their situation. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision: whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home. On Easter Sunday in Italy, Becky and Jamie reveal their decision to the kids during an Easter Egg hunt to an overwhelming reaction. Shortly after, Becky and Jamie fly the kids back to the UK, arriving home for an emotional reunion with family and friends. But when the season is over, will Jamie be joining them for good or stay in Italy - or will a whole new adventure begin?

Elsewhere, Martin treats the local hypochondriac and becomes concerned that he may have been exposed to asbestos while doing roof conversions in the village, and Jennifer is worried when she and Mrs Tishell get a letter from the Pharmaceutical Council saying that Mrs Tishell no longer needs supervision - Bert is miserable about Jennifer leaving as Al tells him that he should do something to get her to stay, and that is exactly what he does...

programme.title: Doc Martin
programme.desc: Comedy-drama series about a curmudgeonly GP. Louisa tries to get Martin to open up about the loss of his father, but Martin says that it doesn't affect him - when Louisa suggests a break so they can all get away and spend some time together, Martin doesn't want to and Louisa is hurt by this. At the same time, things are strained between Martin and his mother - she is trying to connect with him, but he is cutting her off. Elsewhere, Mrs Tishell is smitten by the hand-holding and the staring into her eyes of the Doc during a routine examination and falls head over heels in love with him again, there is a visit at the police station by two military policemen looking for Mike Pruddy, and the wind is taken out of Al's sails when he tells his dad about a business idea he has - to be a middleman between tourists wanting fishing trips and the fishermen - and Bert laughs at the idea as he thinks there is no way that the fishermen will give him a ten per cent cut of their take.

programme.title: Lewis

programme.title: Scott & Bailey
programme.desc: Drama series exploring the personal and professional lives of two female detectives in Manchester. programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: After an emotional farewell to their home and family in the UK, Becky and the kids make the big move to Italy, taking everything with them - including their dogs and grand piano. But Italian life is immediately complicated, with a frustrated Jamie injured and unable to play but desperate to start scoring goals for his new club. The kids love their new Italian home but struggle being away from friends - will Becky and Jamie's grand plans for Sofia's birthday be enough to take her mind off friends back home? With Jamie's punishing training schedule taking its toll, he doesn't get as much time with the family as he'd like, leaving Becky to help them settle in and do her best to source home comforts for the kids - but she can't find baked beans or orange squash anywhere. Still, Jamie makes time for some magic family moments, and the family begin to find their feet, learning the language, experiencing the culture and Jamie makes his much-awaited debut on the pitch with explosive results.

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. Becky and the kids escape to the mountains for a much-needed change of scenery and time to think clearly about their situation. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision: whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home. On Easter Sunday in Italy, Becky and Jamie reveal their decision to the kids during an Easter Egg hunt to an overwhelming reaction. Shortly after, Becky and Jamie fly the kids back to the UK, arriving home for an emotional reunion with family and friends. But when the season is over, will Jamie be joining them for good or stay in Italy - or will a whole new adventure begin?
